assets.label: Ada
assets.description: 24, an ordinary young woman raised near woodland, from her character sheet. Generated sculpted head with her braid over her left shoulder. The clothes are painted on one body with the skin, so they cannot come off.
assets.source: Mike's October 31 character sheet made into a model by Multi-Image to 3D (Meshy) and rigged by 3D Rigging, both on Higgsfield, in the character-sheet proof run; the eight clips from the Meshy library through Higgsfield, retargeted with art-tool.py clips; a head generated through Higgsfield (four GPT Image 2.5 close-up views from her sheet, one Tripo H3.1 Multiview head) and grafted with art-tool.py head, with 1024² maps for the game. The account holder owns the generated outputs. Not yet owner-accepted.
